pkgmetadata.longdescription:
DaVinci Resolve is Blackmagic Design's post-production suite, combining editing, colour grading, visual effects, motion graphics and audio post-production in one application. This package installs the proprietary Linux build; the archive is not redistributable and cannot be fetched automatically, so it must be downloaded by hand from Blackmagic Design and placed in DISTDIR.
The three video_cards_* flags select which compute runtime is pulled in for OpenCL. None of them is required to install the package: Resolve will start without an accelerated runtime, it simply refuses to render.
